title: Unbiased Prevalence Estimation with Multicalibrated LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the absolute percentage point error (bias) in aggregate employment prevalence estimation by evaluating classifiers on synthetic target populations from the American Community Survey that have artificially shifted age distributions (young-skewed, old-skewed, and bimodal).

Evaluating prevalence estimation bias by classifying political texts for 'Law & Crime' topics across four countries and languages, and measuring the error when the model is subjected to out-of-distribution shifts in country composition and document type.

primary_bias_target: Prevalence estimation bias under covariate shift
